states.blurb: Malaysia's capital — vibrant, well-connected and home to some of the country's most sought-after residential addresses.

areas.name: KLCC
areas.description: The city's iconic central business district, framed by the Petronas Twin Towers. Premium high-rise living with unrivalled skyline views and world-class amenities.

areas.name: Mont Kiara
areas.description: An established upmarket township popular with expatriates and families, known for its guarded condominiums, international schools and leafy streets.

areas.name: Ampang
areas.description: A well-located residential district east of the city centre offering a mix of landed homes and condominiums close to the KLCC fringe.

areas.name: Taman Tun Dr Ismail (TTDI)
areas.description: A greenery-rich, family-friendly neighbourhood combining mature landed homes with modern developments, cafes and parks.

areas.name: Cheras
areas.description: One of the largest and most livable residential areas in Kuala Lumpur, offering affordable to mid-range condominiums and landed homes.

areas.name: Setapak
areas.description: A lively and affordable area in northeast KL, popular with young professionals and students, with strong public transport links.

areas.name: Damansara
areas.description: A collection of prime, mature neighbourhoods west of the city known for landed homes, schools and established communities.

states.description: Malaysia's most developed state, surrounding Kuala Lumpur with a diverse range of townships from affordable to premium.

areas.name: Petaling Jaya
areas.description: A mature, well-planned satellite city offering strong connectivity, established amenities and a broad range of property options.

areas.name: Cheras
areas.description: The Selangor portion of Cheras extends the KL suburb seamlessly, with popular condominiums and landed estates.

areas.name: Rawang
areas.description: An emerging township north of KL offering affordable landed homes and growing infrastructure.

areas.name: Shah Alam
areas.description: The state capital of Selangor — a planned, family-oriented city with excellent schools, parkland and quality developments.

areas.name: Subang Jaya / Sunway
areas.description: A thriving, well-connected hub with vibrant commercial areas, excellent transport and a strong choice of condominiums and houses.

areas.name: Klang
areas.description: A historic royal town with a growing property scene, offering some of the most affordable landed homes near KL.

areas.name: Puchong
areas.description: A fast-developing township with great highways access, wide variety of properties and strong community living.

areas.name: Kuala Selangor
areas.description: A coastal district north of KL known for its natural attractions and quiet landed living at approachable prices.

areas.name: Sungai Buloh
areas.description: A strategic township experiencing rapid growth with the new MRT, offering modern condominiums and landed homes.

areas.name: Kajang
areas.description: A major satellite town southeast of KL with the developing Bandar Baru Kajang hub and excellent rail connectivity.

areas.name: Damansara
areas.description: The Selangor side of Damansara encompasses prime townships such as Damansara Perdana, Utama and Damansara Damai.
